title: Spatial concept knowledge graph
description: Exhaustive graph of spatial concepts for the pattern-language workbench: foundations, metric space, morphology, topology, city transportation, circulation, interaction, climate, place roles, language, and owned symbology. Edges: depends_on, parent_of, sibling_of, maps_to, specializes, renders_as.
